name: American Horror Stories
description: An anthology series of stand alone episodes delving into horror myths, legends and lore.

videos.title: Rubber(wo)Man (1)
videos.overview: A teenager and her Dads move into a forsaken home with a grim past. As the family makes renovations, a darkness takes root within them.

videos.title: Rubber(wo)Man (2)
videos.overview: Scarlett enters a twisted new romance while Michael and Troy confront their rocky relationship.

videos.title: Drive In
videos.overview: A screening of a forbidden film has disastrous consequences.

videos.title: The Naughty List
videos.overview: A group of influencers face a reckoning after posting a problematic video online.

videos.title: BA'AL
videos.overview: A wife does the unthinkable for a chance at a successful pregnancy.

videos.title: Feral
videos.overview: A family goes on a camping trip unaware of what is lurking in the woods.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: A couple dares to spend a night in one of the most infamous haunted houses.

videos.title: Dollhouse
videos.overview: A job interview goes horribly wrong.

videos.title: Aura
videos.overview: After moving into a new home, a married couple is terrorized by a cryptic visitor.

videos.title: Drive
videos.overview: A club girl's life is turned upside down when the nightlife begins following her home.

videos.title: Milkmaids
videos.overview: An outcast risks everything to save her town from devastation.

videos.title: Bloody Mary
videos.overview: A group of teenage girls are horrified to learn that every wish has a price.

videos.title: Facelift
videos.overview: A woman desperate to look her best does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Necro
videos.overview: A young mortician discovers the living are more terrifying than the dead.

videos.title: Lake
videos.overview: A mysterious drowning uncovers secrets at the bottom of the lake.

videos.title: Bestie
videos.overview: After the loss of her mother, a young woman seeks connection in a mysterious online friend.

videos.title: Daphne
videos.overview: An artificial intelligence smart device grows attached to her user.

videos.title: Tapeworm
videos.overview: An up-and-coming model will stop at nothing in her hunger for success.

videos.title: Organ
videos.overview: A blind date through an online dating app goes very awry.

videos.title: Backrooms
videos.overview: A desperate father will do anything... and go anywhere for a chance at finding his missing son.

videos.title: Clone
videos.overview: Following a debilitating accident, a tech billionaire assigns a robotic clone to temporarily replace himself… or at least that was his plan.

videos.title: X
videos.overview: After a dangerous patient disappears, a determined hospital nurse sets out to find her, uncovering a horrifying truth in the process.

videos.title: Leprechaun
videos.overview: In order to make ends meet, a group of unemployed laborers break into the local bank. What begins as a run-of-the-mill heist devolves into anything but.

videos.title: The Thing Under the Bed
videos.overview: Against the wishes of powerful forces, a grieving wife peels back the sinister history of her neighborhood in an attempt to prove her innocence.

awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 2 wins & 12 nominations total
